# Create с Skyblock

Простой и минималистичный модпак, в основном сосредоточенный на модах Create и Farmer's Delight в условиях Skyblock.

Также добавляет множество модов для строительства и пытается решить проблему управления инвентарем в игре.

## Список модов

<details>
<summary>Skyblock</summary>

- [Standard SkyBlock](https://modrinth.com/datapack/standard-skyblock)
- [Изменения таблиц лута для SkyBlock](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bayis-create-sykblock-loot-table)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Create / Farmer's Delight</summary>

- [Create](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-fabric)  
- [Create Deco](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-deco)
- [Create Slice & Dice](https://modrinth.com/mod/slice-and-dice)
- [Create: Steam 'n' Rails](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-steam-n-rails)
- [Create Track Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/create-track-map)
- [Farmer's Delight](https://modrinth.com/mod/farmers-delight-fabric)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Моды для строительства</summary>

- [Chipped](https://modrinth.com/mod/chipped)
- [Immersive Paintings](https://modrinth.com/mod/immersive-paintings)
- [More Slabs Stairs & Walls](https://modrinth.com/mod/more-slabs-stairs-and-walls)
- [Open Simple Frames](https://modrinth.com/mod/open-simple-frames)
- [Paladin's Furniture Mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/paladins-furniture)
- [Beautify: Refabricated](https://modrinth.com/mod/beautify-refabricated)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Моды для инвентаря / хранилища</summary>

- [Traveler's Backpack](https://modrinth.com/mod/travelersbackpack)
- [Extended Drawers](https://modrinth.com/mod/extended-drawers)
- [Gravestones](https://modrinth.com/mod/gravestones)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Моды для производительности</summary>

- [Lithium](https://modrinth.com/mod/lithium)
</details>

<details>
<summary>Моды для удобства игры</summary>

- [JEI](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei)
- [Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)
- [Waystones](https://modrinth.com/mod/waystones)
- [Xaero's Minimap](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-minimap)
- [Xaero's World Map](https://modrinth.com/mod/xaeros-world-map)
- [Simple Voice Chat](https://modrinth.com/plugin/simple-voice-chat)
- [Freecam](https://modrinth.com/mod/freecam)
- [Athena](https://modrinth.com/mod/athena-ctm)
- [Patchouli](https://modrinth.com/mod/patchouli)
- [Global Datapacks](https://modrinth.com/mod/datapacks)
- [CC:Tweaked](https://modrinth.com/mod/cc-tweaked)
</details>

## Примечания

Этот модпак в основном предназначен для моих друзей и семьи / для личного использования, но любые отзывы приветствуются. Не стесняйтесь связываться со мной, если у вас есть предложения или идеи.
